telesterion.title: Telesterion
telesterion.text: The square hall where the initiates of Demeter and Kore gathered. Its Periclean rebuilding is under way: Koroibos began it, Metagenes and Xenokles will finish it, Plutarch says; the roof is not finished.

rarian.title: Farmer
rarian.text: Eleusis' Rarian plain was where, the story said, Demeter first taught men to sow barley.

telesterion_builder.title: Builder
telesterion_builder.text: Masons at work on the Periclean Telesterion, the hall of the Mysteries, still without its roof.

eleusis_first_fruits.title: Aparchai
eleusis_first_fruits.text: An Athenian decree of about these years asked the farmers of Attica, and invited all Greeks, to bring a share of their barley and wheat to the two goddesses at Eleusis. The grain was stored in pits in the sanctuary and sold to pay for offerings and dedications.

mysteries.title: The Mysteries
mysteries.text: Each autumn the initiates walked the Sacred Way from Athens to Demeter's sanctuary, calling on Iakchos, and arrived at torchlight. What was shown inside the Telesterion was never told: to speak of it was a crime, and the secret was kept for a thousand years.

strings.first_visit: Eleusis, on its bay. The Sacred Way from Athens ends at the gate of Demeter's sanctuary.
strings.market_day: Market day: stalls, voices and goods from the country around.
strings.market_rain: Rain: the stallholders cover their goods and wait under the eaves.
strings.lamps_lit: Dusk: the lamps are lit along the street.
strings.wedding: A wedding: the bride is led to her new home with torches and songs.
strings.shearing: Shearing time: the flocks come in.
strings.threshing: The threshing floors are busy from dawn.
strings.vintage: The vintage: the grapes are trodden in the vats.
strings.rural_dionysia: The country Dionysia: a procession with songs, a goat and the aulos.
strings.mysteries: The initiates arrive from Athens by the Sacred Way.
strings.season_turn.spring: The swallows are back under the eaves.
strings.season_turn.autumn: The grapes are in: the vintage begins.
strings.season_turn.nov: Cranes call high overhead, flying in a long V.
strings.season_turn.oct: The first rain. The whole land smells of dust and earth.
strings.season_turn.winter: Braziers glow in the doorways against the cold.

era.note: still at peace: the war begins in the spring of 431, which the calendar never reaches, because spring returns to 432
